about_the_game:
DEMO COMING SOON

Explore the ruined Taurus II Colony Ship

Find your way through an interconnected world and uncover long forgotten memories buried beneath an eternity of dust and death. Hunt the wraiths threatening existence itself, or destroy the order holding them back. Whether snaking through narrow hallways or exploring large open spaces, your sense of direction will be put to the test every step along the way.

Find powerful equipment

Assemble your offensive and defensive arsenal from many different weapons, modules and ships. Select the best tools for the challenges you face, or overcome them with sheer determination. Choose from over 40 different weapons from different categories and engulf your opponents in a storm of bullets, missiles, lasers and much more.

Defeat imposing foes in action packed dogfights

Weave through enemy attacks, outsmart and overwhelm their systems, and take down challenging bosses in a light show of fiery explosions and vibrant projectiles. Perfect your positioning, timing and awareness so that none will be able to touch you, but be warned: your adversaries will do the same.

short_description: Explore the vast ruin of a massive colony ship, find powerful weapons, ships and equipment, and decide the fate of existence itself. Dodge bullets, distract missiles and outmaneuver your enemies, then retaliate with lasers and heavy artillery.
